name: Sundaram Krishnan
summary: Android engineer with around 12 years of experience in mobile development, starting with Java before moving to Kotlin. Architected a Kotlin application from scratch using Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM). Owns the full Android stack for Linkthread at Zoho.

bullets: Own Linkthread's Android architecture and implementation, including the Jetpack Compose UI, database, offline design, networking, security, WebView and its JavaScript bridge, and testing.
Maintain AGENTS.md and manage project context across Claude Code, Cursor and Antigravity, reducing token usage and improving coding throughput.
Develop Android features for Zoho Social with iOS, backend, product management and QA teams, aligning behavior across mobile and web clients.

experience.company: Tranxit Technology Solutions Pvt Ltd (Appstars Applications)
bullets: Architected and developed a multi-service, on-demand application from scratch using Kotlin, MVVM and Data Binding.
Structured the application for scalability, code maintainability and testability.
Communicated with clients throughout the development lifecycle, sharing progress updates, addressing concerns and gathering feedback.

items: Evaluating trade-offs in architecture, maintainability and delivery time
